contracts: (For every retained seed, validation terminates with exactly one of: accepted_with_counterexample, accepted_with_explicit_absence, or rejected_missing_or_ambiguous_counterexample_status; no unrelated evidence may determine the status.) AND (The S19 pytest selector proves that a complete retained seed passes this metadata check and that the same retained seed with missing-label metadata removed is rejected without inference.) AND (The S19 structural validation observes exactly one complete architecture-index-gap seed record with its required metadata and classification.) AND (The authored selector rejects absent, duplicate, incomplete, or non-approved classification records and accepts only one complete non-baseline record.) AND (The targeted RMAP-S2 validator test proves that omitted applicability and false applicability are rejected, while the complete manifest with explicit true applicability passes the applicability check.)

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["py", "-3", "-B", "execution-plans/2026-08-05-toolchain-core-skill-replay-portability-and-evaluation-seed/tools/validate_implementation.py", "--slice", "RMAP-S2"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
selector_intents: A retained seed record is accepted or assigned counterexample status without an explicit status field grounded in that record.
Execute the authored S19 seed-validation test against missing, duplicate, or incomplete candidate-baseline-contamination metadata and observe rejection.
Execute the authored S19 selector against absent, duplicate, or incomplete architecture-index-gap seed metadata; it must fail structural seed validation.
Run the S19 pytest case against a retained-seed variant that removes only its missing-label metadata; the validator must report the missing metadata rather than accept or infer it.
Run the existing RMAP-S2 validator test with an otherwise-valid retained seed whose applicability is first omitted and then false; each variant must be rejected by the applicability check.
The validation contract omits the required rejection when a retained seed has neither a counterexample nor an explicit-absence declaration.
